query: What is the punishment for criminal intimidation?

forbidden_contradiction_skips.point: The punishment for all criminal intimidation is always seven years.
forbidden_contradiction_skips.sentence: According to Section 351(4) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, whoever commits the offense of criminal intimidation by an anonymous communication, or takes precautions to conceal their identity, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, in addition to any other punishment provided for the offense under subsection (1).
forbidden_contradiction_skips.reason: forbidden point is absolute, but answer sentence is conditional or alternative

required_point_details.point: Section 351(2) provides that whoever commits criminal intimidation shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, or with fine, or with both.

Section 351(3) provides that if the threat is to cause death or grievous hurt, destruction of property by fire, commission of an offence punishable with death or imprisonment for life or up to seven years, or to impute unchastity to a woman, the punishment is imprisonment up to seven years, or fine, or both.
Section 351(4) provides an additional two years if the threat is made by anonymous communication or with concealment of identity.

final_answer_preview: According to Section 351(4) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, whoever commits the offense of criminal intimidation by an anonymous communication, or takes precautions to conceal their identity, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years, in addition to any other punishment provided for the offense under subsection (1).
